make_cfg: build a Habitat-Sim simulator configuration from a settings dictionary with sensor specs and agent config
make_default_settings: create a default settings dictionary for Habitat-Sim with scene path, sensor height, and physics enabled
make_simulator_from_settings: initialize a Habitat-Sim simulator instance from settings and load object template managers
build_dict_from_template: build a dictionary of editable and read-only attribute properties from a Habitat-Sim template object
simulate: run physics simulation for a given number of world seconds at 60Hz and return sensor observations
